name: Checkbox
purpose: Lets users select zero or more independent options, or confirm a single statement (accept terms). Changes take effect on form submit.

props.name: label
props.description: Visible label. Required even when hidden.

props.name: hideLabel
props.description: Visually hide the label (e.g. table row selection) while keeping it for screen readers.

props.name: indeterminate
props.description: Mixed state for a parent 'select all' checkbox.

states.name: checked
states.description: Filled intent.primary.bg with a check mark.

states.name: invalid
states.description: border.danger and error message with icon.

screenReader: Description and error are read after the label via aria-describedby.
accessibility.focus: Focus ring drawn on the visual box when the hidden native input has :focus-visible.
accessibility.touchTarget: Hit area extends to 32px (44px on touch); clicking the label also toggles.
notes: Group related checkboxes in a <fieldset> with a <legend> describing the question.

variants.name: with description
variants.description: Adds helper text below the label.

variants.name: hidden label
variants.description: Used in data tables for row selection.

do: Write labels as positive statements ('Send me match reminders').
Use indeterminate for a parent that controls a list.
dont: Don't use a checkbox for settings that apply instantly; use Toggle.
Don't use for mutually exclusive options; use RadioGroup.
Don't rely on the checkbox alone to indicate errors; show a message.

related.name: DataTable
related.reason: Row selection uses Checkbox with hideLabel.

example.web:
<Checkbox label="Send me match reminders" description="We'll email you 1 hour before kickoff." defaultChecked />
<Checkbox label="I accept the rules" required error={errors.rules} />
example.native: <Checkbox label="Send me match reminders" checked={remind} onCheckedChange={setRemind} />
